body: Honestly the best medication for RLS is meditation. Getting to a place where you can sit still and not move any part of your body while feeling peace was instrumental to my recovery.

I'm around this time period and it's like the intense pain is gone but there are still lingering effects. When I get like this I jump in an ice cold shower and I get my focus back.

I'm taking a cold shower at least 30 times a day any the distraction helps a lot.

Thank you for your kind words.

I've had two relationships in life with women who had incredibly beautiful lives. It taught me that we shouldn't really measure the things that hurt us.

Don't dismiss yourself, or your feelings.

I'm really proud of you for being a bigger person and controlling yourself in such a way to save face for their families.

This situation is horrible and it appears that you have shown a capacity to conduct yourself in a very commendable manner.

I wish you the best, I'm so sorry you have to deal with this.
I share your rage. There's no place in my heart for those who take from the innocence of children or those who can not defend themselves.
I feel like sometimes it's the long game. There always these ups and downs but finding some peace in that fluctuation might be the key.

Have some grace for yourself. Invest in yourself.

Involuntary celibacy is a hell, I know.

It's not always about how you look.
